messages:
Tara (People Ops): @channel Quick update: NYC is expecting a midweek snowstorm on Wed Feb 7 with heavy street plowing and some bus delays. Options for that day: 1) WFH, 2) Use the Midtown satellite space (limited), or 3) Ride a company shuttle from Grand Central (limited seats). Please pick your plan here by EOD Tue: https://tinyurl.com/nyc-snow-options

Ibrahim (Facilities): Midtown satellite has 30 desks and heated lockers for boots/coats. We'll open the warm-up area in Suite 12A and provide boot trays. If you need an accessible desk, mark it on the form.

Marta (Travel Ops): Shuttle plan (tentative):
```
06:45 | Grand Central (42nd St entrance)
07:10 | Bryant Park (north)
07:30 | Office arrival
```
Reserve with "shuttle: yes" on the form. If shuttle fills, we'll reimburse rideshares up to $50 one-way when booked due to weather.

Evan: If I end up driving from Jersey, is there any validated parking?

Ibrahim (Facilities): Short-term validated parking at Lot H (near 9th Ave) for staff using the shuttle or satellite. Put your plate in the form. No overnight parking. We'll also have a boot-clean station at entry.

Sofia: I need daycare help — my usual sitter may cancel in snow. Any stipend?

Tara (People Ops): We can provide a one-time child/eldercare stipend up to $75 if your regular care cancels because of the storm. Choose "childcare" on the form and submit the receipt after. We'll fast-track approvals for people who need it same-day.

TransitBot: transit-bot alert: MTA anticipates bus detours; subway service currently expected to run but NYPD may restrict streets downtown. Travel delays likely 06:30-10:30.

Marta (Travel Ops): If you choose WFH, mark your calendar as "Remote - Snow" so teams know. Managers: decide if any onsite coverage is required and post expectations by Tue EOD.

Evan: Will lunch be provided at the satellite? I have dietary restrictions (no shellfish).

Ibrahim (Facilities): We'll have boxed lunches with GF/veg/veg-animal-free options. Add dietary notes on the form. Also hot cider and electrolyte packets will be available.

Sofia: shuttle: yes (if seat available)

Tara (People Ops): calendar-bot created event: "NYC Snow Day Options" Feb 7 06:30-18:00 (labels: people-ops). Final confirmations and shuttle roster will be posted Wed 05:30 AM. If the storm gets worse and HQ closes, we will post an all-hands closure notice here. Stay safe and plan extra commute time :snowflake: :car:
